info.title: Kejasha API
info.description: Property management, rent collection and short-stay management for Kenya. Money is integer cents (int64). Business dates are Africa/Nairobi. Every write accepts an Idempotency-Key header. Errors are RFC 9457 problem+json.

bearerAuth.description: Session token from sign-in (`token` in the response). Used by Android.

endDate.description: Inclusive last day; omit for an open-ended tenancy

CreateLeaseBodyInput.description: Creates the lease, invoices the deposit and bills every period already due. escalationBps and escalationEveryMonths go together; lateFeeKind flat needs lateFeeFlatCents, percent needs lateFeeBps (422 invalid_lease_terms). Overlapping a unit's existing lease answers 409 lease_overlap.

billingDay.description: Day rent falls due (clamped to month end). Default 1.

UpdateLeaseBodyInput.description: Applies to invoices not yet issued. escalationBps and escalationEveryMonths go together; lateFeeKind flat needs lateFeeFlatCents, percent needs lateFeeBps (422 invalid_lease_terms)

RentChangeBodyInput.description: New rent from a future (not yet invoiced) month; escalation restarts from it

endDate.description: New inclusive end date, or null for open-ended

TerminateLeaseBodyInput.description: Ends the lease; later invoices are voided and the final month is prorated
